t: Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said : The whole of asceticism is confined between two expressions of the Qur'an. Allah, the Glorified says : Lest distress you yourself tor what escapes you, and be overjoyous for what He has granted you (Qur'an, 57:23). Whoever does not grieve over what he misses and does not revel over what comes to him acquires asceticism from both its sides.
